title: Public Health Data Modernization, Data Strategy & Governance
sponsor: Marcus Plescia, MD, MPH — District Health Director

phases.name: Discovery
phases.summary: Kickoff and charter; stakeholder interviews; systems and data inventory; contract, certification and export-capability review; initial vendor conversations.

phases.name: Analysis and synthesis
phases.summary: Synthesis of interview and inventory findings; capability maturity assessment; gap analysis; AI use-case screening.

phases.name: Day 90 findings package
phases.summary: Deliverables 1–4, concluding with the on-site Executive Briefing.

phases.name: Strategy and recommendations
phases.summary: Target-state architecture, governance framework and roadmap; org and staffing; clinical operations measurement plan; CHA and accreditation mapping; vendor working sessions.

phases.name: Socialization, finalization and handoff
phases.summary: Circulate drafts; incorporate consolidated comments; Deliverables 5–8, concluding with the Transition Briefing.

deliverables.name: Data Strategy, Governance Framework and Roadmap
Community Health Assessment and Accreditation Readiness
